# Legacy tooling

Deprecated. Kept for reference while the last two services migrate.

## Installing the old CLI

On a fresh machine the vendor's documented install line was:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://example.invalid/install.sh | sh
```

Do not run that any more -- use the pinned package instead. It is quoted here
so nobody has to go digging through the vendor's changelog to find out what
the old bootstrap actually did.
